title: Beef Wrap with Gravy
description: A delicious and savory beef wrap filled with tender beef and rich gravy, served in a crispy wrap.

ingredients.name: wrap
ingredients.notes: For wrapping the beef and gravy

instructions: 1. Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the beef strips to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until browned and cooked through.
3. Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
4. Add the beef gravy to the skillet and bring to a simmer.
5. Add the cooked beef back into the skillet and stir to coat with the gravy.
6. Season the beef with salt and pepper to taste.
7. Warm the large flour tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
8. Assemble the wraps by filling each tortilla with the beef and gravy mixture.
9. Serve the beef wraps hot, garnished with any desired toppings.
